0.title: Stage 0: frozen B3 with soma current recording at sweeps 56, 50, 53 (200, 250, 310 pA)
0.prediction: Counts 4, 8, 10 (h01-e-gain/stage-g0-decision.json); every rise-crossing time within 0.1 ms and every trough within 0.1 mV of g0-b3 (the probes do not change the solution beyond CVode noise); axon-first initiation at all three inputs. Between spikes at 200 pA the applied command exceeds the summed outward soma currents by a small margin that the recorded terms make explicit; Nap, Im, SK and Ih magnitudes in the interspike windows are measured, not predicted.
0.rejection: A different count at any input, or a crossing beyond 0.1 ms, means the recording option or the executor changed the model: stop, record the difference, and do not open stage 1.
